Moves Facebook's tab bar to the top, under the search row, as older Facebook had it. Restart Facebook to see the change.
column2: 像舊版 Facebook 那樣，把 Facebook 的標籤欄移到頂部、搜尋欄下方。重啟 Facebook 後可看到更改。

The bottom tab bar hides as you scroll down and returns when you scroll up, for more room. Restart Facebook to see the change.
column2: 向下滾動時隱藏底部標籤欄，向上滾動時再顯示，以騰出更多空間。重啟 Facebook 後可看到更改。

The bottom tab bar stays put while you scroll, on accounts where Facebook slides it away. Restart Facebook to see the change.
column2: 在 Facebook 會收起底部標籤欄的賬號上，滾動時讓它保持不動。重啟 Facebook 後可看到更改。

column2: 保持頂部欄顯示

The top bar with search and Messenger stays put while you scroll down, instead of sliding away.
column2: 向下滾動時，帶搜尋和 Messenger 的頂部欄保持不動，不再滑走。

column2: 大螢幕上使用手機佈局

column1: # context: description of that switch; on a big screen Facebook keeps the tab bar at the top in a wider layout, so the tab bar switches above it do nothing there

A tablet or an unfolded phone gets the layout Facebook uses on a phone, so the tab bar switches above work on the big screen too. Facebook's wider big screen layout goes away. Off by default, since it hasn't been tried on a big screen yet. Restart Facebook to see the change.
column2: 平板或展開的摺疊屏手機會使用 Facebook 在手機上的佈局，這樣上面的標籤欄開關在大螢幕上也能生效。Facebook 較寬的大屏幕布局將不再出現。預設關閉，因為尚未在大螢幕上試過。重啟 Facebook 後可看到更改。

column2: 透明欄

column1: # context: description of that switch; the feed is the list of posts on Home, and blurred means frosted like glass
The top bar and the tab bar turn see-through, so the feed shows through them as you scroll. On Android 12 and newer the feed behind them is blurred.
column2: 頂部欄和標籤欄變為透明，滾動時動態訊息會透過它們顯示出來。在 Android 12 及更高版本上，它們後面的動態訊息會模糊顯示。

column2: 強制深色模式

column1: # context: description of that switch; on some tablets Facebook's own Settings page has no Dark mode row

column2: 無論 Facebook 自己的設定如何，都保持 Facebook 為深色。適用於 Facebook 沒有深色模式開關的平板。重啟 Facebook 後可看到更改。

column2: 黑色卡片

column1: # context: description of that switch; a card is a raised panel such as a post or the Menu's profile box, near black is the dark gray the theme gives it

Cards and menus take the page's own color instead of the near black that sets them apart. Buttons and search fields keep a dark gray fill, so you can still see them. Restart Facebook to see the change.
column2: 卡片和選單改用頁面本身的顏色，而不是用來區分它們的近黑色。按鈕和搜尋框保留深灰色填充，讓你仍能看清。重啟 Facebook 後可看到更改。

column1: No app on this phone can open the link. The address is %1$s.
column2: 這部手機上沒有應用可以開啟該連結。地址是 %1$s。

column1: Hushfacebook pauses when Facebook restarts.
column2: Facebook 重啟時，Hushfacebook 會暫停。

column1: Pause, backup and diagnostics
column2: 暫停、備份和診斷

column1: Updates
column2: 更新

column1: Stop update prompts
column2: 停止更新提示

column1: Stops update nagging through Meta App Manager and hides chat promotions for older versions. A patched Facebook can't use Meta's updates anyway.
column2: 停止通過 Meta App Manager 反覆提醒更新，並隱藏針對舊版本的聊天推廣。已修補的 Facebook 本來也無法使用 Meta 的更新。

column1: Hides reels and Watch videos that Facebook marks as made with AI. Ones only their creator labeled stay. Off by default, since it hasn't been tried on a real account yet.
column2: 隱藏 Facebook 標記為 AI 製作的 Reels 和 Watch 影片。僅由創作者自行標註的會保留。預設關閉，因為尚未在真實賬號上試過。

column1: Don't send reel watch history
column2: 不傳送 Reels 觀看記錄

column1: Hold back analytics uploads
column2: 限制分析資料上傳

column1: Stops Facebook sending usage statistics in the background and running its on-phone learning tasks. Restart Facebook to see the change.
column2: 阻止 Facebook 在後臺傳送使用統計資料，並阻止它執行手機端的學習任務。重啟 Facebook 後可看到更改。

column1: # context: switch title under Privacy; camera roll means the photos and videos saved on the phone, and sharing suggestions is Facebook's own feature name, so use Facebook's wording in your language if you know it
Hold back camera roll processing
column2: 限制相機膠捲處理

column1: # context: description of that switch; the report is a count of the photos and videos on the phone

Stops the camera roll processing behind sharing suggestions, which goes through your photos and videos and uploads photos and details about them, and stops the report of how many you have. Restart Facebook to see the change.
column2: 停止為分享建議而進行的相機膠捲處理（它會遍歷你的照片和影片，並上傳照片及其詳細資訊），同時停止上報你有多少張照片和影片。重啟 Facebook 後可看到更改。

column1: # context: switch title under Privacy; link history is Facebook's own name for its list of links you opened in its built-in browser, so use Facebook's wording in your language if you know it
Stop link history in Facebook's browser
column2: 停止 Facebook 瀏覽器中的連結歷史記錄

column1: # context: description of that switch; Facebook's own browser is the one built into the app
Links that open in Facebook's own browser aren't recorded for your link history or sent to Facebook as pages you visited. Applies to the next link you open.
column2: 在 Facebook 內建瀏覽器中開啟的連結不會被記入你的連結歷史記錄，也不會作為你訪問過的頁面傳送給 Facebook。對你下次開啟的連結生效。

column1: Allow screenshots
column2: 允許截圖

column1: Lets you take screenshots and screen recordings on pages where Facebook blocks them. Reopen a page that's already open.
column2: 在 Facebook 禁止截圖和錄屏的頁面上也允許截圖和錄屏。請重新開啟已開啟的頁面。

column1: Block screenshot detection
column2: 遮蔽截圖檢測

column1: Hide typing in chats
column2: 在聊天中隱藏正在輸入狀態

column1: Hide typing in comments
column2: 在評論中隱藏正在輸入狀態

column1: People you chat with in Facebook's own chats can't see when you're typing. Messages send as usual.
column2: 在 Facebook 自帶聊天中與你聊天的人看不到你正在輸入。訊息照常傳送。

column1: People looking at a post don't see that you're writing a comment.
column2: 檢視帖子的人看不到你正在撰寫評論。

column1: Hide read receipts
column2: 隱藏已讀回執

column1: People you chat with in Facebook's own chats can't see that you've read their messages. The chat can stay unread on this phone.
column2: 在 Facebook 自帶聊天中與你聊天的人看不到你已讀他們的訊息。這部手機上的聊天可以保持未讀狀態。

column1: Facebook can't tell when you take a screenshot or record your screen, so it can't react.
column2: Facebook 無法得知你何時截圖或錄屏，因此不會作出反應。

column1: Stops sending Facebook your list of watched reels. It uses the list to rank your feed, so reels you've watched may come back.
column2: 停止向 Facebook 傳送你已觀看的 Reels 列表。它會用這份列表為你的動態訊息排序，所以你看過的 Reels 可能會再次出現。

column1: # context: switch title under Reels and Watch; the Reels tab shows the most recently posted reels before older ones
Newest reels first
column2: 最新 Reels 優先

column1: # context: summary of that switch; "loaded" means the reels the app has already downloaded in the background, "placed" means reels already lined up as the next ones

The Reels tab plays the newest posted of the reels Facebook has loaded for you first, instead of its own pick. It can't fetch newer ones, and reels already placed stay put. Off by default, since it hasn't been tried on a real account yet.
column2: Reels 標籤頁會在 Facebook 已為你載入的 Reels 中優先播放最新發布的，而不是 Facebook 自己挑選的順序。它無法獲取更新的 Reels，已排好的 Reels 保持原位。預設關閉，因為還沒有在真實賬號上試過。

column1: # context: what stays in while Hushfacebook is paused, shown before the patch's name in brackets; the patch raises the app's version number so Google Play never offers an update
Meta's apps can install beside this one
column2: Meta 的應用可與此應用並存安裝

column1: Messenger, Facebook Lite, Business Suite and Workplace can install next to this Facebook. Their shared permissions no longer clash.
column2: Messenger、Facebook Lite、Business Suite 和 Workplace 可以與這個 Facebook 並存安裝。它們共用的許可權不再衝突。

column1: # context: settings section heading for the Open on a chosen tab rows
Opening Facebook
column2: 開啟 Facebook

column1: # context: switch title; the list below it picks the tab
Open on a chosen tab
column2: 從所選標籤頁開啟

column1: Choose where Facebook opens from its icon. Notifications and links still open their destination.
column2: 選擇從圖示開啟 Facebook 時進入的位置。通知和連結仍會開啟各自的目的地。

column1: # context: title of the list of tabs Facebook can open on
Tab to open on
column2: 開啟時進入的標籤頁

column1: # context: the names of Facebook's own tabs, as its tab bar shows them
Home
column2: 主頁

column1: Feeds
column2: 動態

column1: Video
column2: 影片

column1: Friends
column2: 好友

column1: Marketplace
column2: Marketplace

column1: # context: a tab's name, as Facebook's tab bar shows it; the list of tabs Facebook can open on
Events
column2: 活動

column1: Notifications
column2: 通知

column1: Menu
column2: 選單

column1: # context: summary of the tab list; %1$s is one of the tab names above
Facebook opens on %1$s. If your tab bar doesn't have it, Facebook opens on Home.
column2: Facebook 會開啟 %1$s。如果你的標籤欄中沒有它，Facebook 會開啟主頁。

column1: # context: summary of the tab list when Feeds is picked; off the tab bar, Feeds opens as its own page over Home
Facebook opens on Feeds. If your tab bar doesn't have it, the Feeds page opens over Home.
column2: Facebook 會開啟“動態”。如果你的標籤欄中沒有它，“動態”頁面會在主頁之上開啟。

column1: # context: a sentence in the settings import preview and its toast; %1$s is a tab name
Facebook will open on %1$s.
column2: Facebook 將開啟 %1$s。

column1: # context: switch title under Opening Facebook; Following is Facebook's feed of the friends, Pages and groups you follow, and Home is the tab
Following feed on Home
column2: 主頁顯示關注動態

column1: # context: summary of that switch; the ranked feed is the one Facebook orders for you, and the Feeds tab has its own filters
Home shows the newest posts from friends, groups and Pages you follow, like All in the Feeds tab, or the filter you pick below. The Feeds tab's filters don't change.
column2: 主頁顯示你關注的好友、小組和公共主頁的最新帖子，就像“動態”標籤頁中的“全部”，或你在下方選擇的篩選條件。“動態”標籤頁的篩選條件不會改變。

column1: Jump to a section
column2: 跳轉到某個部分

column1: Go straight to one group of settings. Back returns to where you were.
column2: 直接前往某一組設定。點按“返回”可回到原來的位置。

column1: # context: switch title under Downloads; on, every video save keeps to formats other apps accept
Save videos other apps can open
column2: 儲存其他應用能開啟的影片

column1: # context: summary of that switch; WhatsApp is a name and stays as it is, and saves are the videos the user saved to the phone
Fixes saved videos that play without sound in WhatsApp, video editors such as CapCut and InShot, or some galleries and players. May lower quality.
column2: 修復已儲存的影片在 WhatsApp、CapCut 和 InShot 等影片編輯器，或某些相簿和播放器中播放時沒有聲音的問題。可能會降低畫質。

column1: # context: title of a switch under Downloads; convert means re-encoding the video on the phone
Convert to keep the full size
column2: 轉換以保留原始尺寸

column1: # context: summary of that switch; Save videos other apps can open is the switch above it, VP9, AV1 and H.264 are video formats and stay as they are

With Save videos other apps can open on, a full size video Facebook only has as VP9 or AV1 is converted to H.264 on your phone instead of saved smaller. Slower, and videos over 10 minutes stay smaller.
column2: 開啟“儲存其他應用能開啟的影片”後，Facebook 只提供 VP9 或 AV1 格式的原尺寸影片會在手機上轉換為 H.264，而不是儲存成更小的尺寸。速度較慢，超過 10 分鐘的影片仍會儲存為較小尺寸。

column1: # context: switch title under Downloads; on, a save shows no message when it starts, finishes or is canceled
Quiet saves
column2: 靜默儲存

column1: # context: summary of that switch; a toast is Android's short message at the bottom of the screen
No toast when a save starts, finishes or is canceled. A save that fails still says why.
column2: 儲存開始、完成或被取消時不顯示提示。儲存失敗時仍會說明原因。

column1: # context: section title for the Chats settings, named like Facebook's own Chats screen
Chats
column2: 聊天

column1: # context: switch title under Chats; the card is Facebook's own "Get the Messenger app" card
Hide the Get Messenger card
column2: 隱藏“獲取 Messenger”卡片

column1: # context: summary of that switch; Messenger is the app's name and stays as it is
Hides the card at the top of Chats that asks you to get Messenger, once Messenger is installed. Without Messenger, the card stays.
column2: 在已安裝 Messenger 的情況下，隱藏聊天頂部要求你獲取 Messenger 的卡片。沒有 Messenger 時，該卡片會保留。

column1: # context: switch title under Chats; the notes and active now row is the row of friends' notes and who's active above the chat list in Chats inside Facebook
Hide the notes and active now row
column2: 隱藏便籤和線上好友行

column1: # context: summary of that switch
Removes the row above your chats that shows friends' notes and who's active. Your own note tile may go too. Your chats stay.
column2: 移除聊天上方顯示好友便籤和誰線上的那一行。你自己的便籤塊也可能一併消失。你的聊天仍會保留。

column1: # context: switch title under Chats; promotions are the banners Facebook puts at the top of the chat list
Hide chat list promotions
column2: 隱藏聊天列表推廣

column1: # context: summary of that switch
Hides the banners at the top of Chats, like the one asking you to turn on notifications.
column2: 隱藏聊天頂部的橫幅，例如要求你開啟通知的那一條。

column1: # context: switch title under Chats; Meta AI is Meta's assistant and keeps its name; the button sits beside the search box at the top of Chats and on Chats' search screen
Hide the Meta AI button in Chats
column2: 隱藏聊天中的 Meta AI 按鈕

column1: # context: summary of that switch; your chats with Meta AI are conversations with the assistant, which stay in the list
Removes the Meta AI button beside the search box in Chats, at the top of the list and on the search screen. The search box stays, and so do your chats with Meta AI.
column2: 移除聊天中搜索框旁的 Meta AI 按鈕，包括列表頂部和搜尋頁面上的。搜尋框保留，你與 Meta AI 的聊天也保留。

column1: # context: switch title under Chats; on, Facebook's Messenger icon opens the Messenger app
Open the Messenger app
column2: 開啟 Messenger 應用

column1: # context: summary of that switch; Messenger is the app's name, Chats is Facebook's own chat screen as named above
Tapping the Messenger icon at the top of Facebook opens the Messenger app instead of Chats. Without Messenger, Chats opens as before.
column2: 點按 Facebook 頂部的 Messenger 圖示時，開啟 Messenger 應用而不是“聊天”。沒有 Messenger 時，仍像以前一樣開啟“聊天”。

column1: # context: switch title under Chats; on, Facebook leaves ringing for calls and notifying about chats to the Messenger app
Leave calls and chats to Messenger
column2: 通話和聊天交給 Messenger

column1: # context: summary of that switch; signed out means not logged in to the Messenger app, turned off means the app is disabled in Android's settings

Facebook leaves calls and chat notifications to Messenger while Messenger is installed and enabled. Restart Facebook after changing this switch, or after installing, removing, enabling or disabling Messenger, so call routing updates. If you're signed out of Messenger, you'll miss calls and messages.
column2: 只要 Messenger 已安裝並啟用，Facebook 就把來電和聊天通知交給 Messenger 處理。更改此開關後，或安裝、解除安裝、啟用、停用 Messenger 後，請重啟 Facebook，以更新通話路由。如果你已退出 Messenger 登入，就會錯過來電和訊息。

column1: # context: settings section heading for the Tap to play switch
Playback
column2: 播放

column1: # context: switch title; on, videos and music wait for a tap before they play
Tap to play
column2: 點按播放

column1: # context: summary of that switch; Autoplay and Off are the name and value of Facebook's own setting, as Facebook shows them in this language
Videos, reels, stories and music wait for your tap instead of playing by themselves. Facebook's own Autoplay setting shows Off while this is on.
column2: 影片、Reels、快拍和音樂會等你點按後才播放，而不是自動播放。開啟此項時，Facebook 自己的“自動播放”設定會顯示為“關閉”。

column1: # context: switch title under Opening Facebook; Marketplace is Facebook's tab and keeps its name
Marketplace only
column2: 僅 Marketplace

column1: # context: switch title under Opening Facebook, next to Marketplace only; Events is Facebook's tab and keeps its name
Events only
column2: 僅活動

column1: # context: summary of that switch; the tab names are Facebook's own, as its tab bar shows them
# context: switch title under Menu; Upgrades is the name of a section in Facebook's own Menu
Hide Upgrades
column2: 隱藏“升級”

column1: # context: summary of that switch; Settings and Help and support are Facebook's own Menu sections
The Upgrades section and its offers leave Facebook's Menu. Settings, Help and support and the rest of the Menu stay.
column2: “升級”部分及其優惠將從 Facebook 選單中消失。“設定”、“幫助和支援”以及選單的其餘部分保留。

column1: # context: switch title under Menu; Also from Meta is the name of a section in Facebook's own Menu
Hide Also from Meta
column2: 隱藏“Meta 旗下更多產品”

column1: Hide the Muse card
column2: 隱藏 Muse 卡片

column1: The Muse card, Meta's ad for its AI agent app, leaves the top of Facebook's Menu.
column2: Muse 卡片（Meta 為其 AI 智慧體應用做的廣告）將從 Facebook 選單頂部消失。

column1: # context: summary of that switch; the section links to Meta's other apps and shows ads for its devices
The Also from Meta section leaves Facebook's Menu, with its links to Meta's other apps and its ads for Meta's devices. Your own shortcuts stay.
column2: “Meta 旗下更多產品”部分將從 Facebook 選單中消失，包括指向 Meta 其他應用的連結和 Meta 裝置的廣告。你自己的快捷方式保留。

column1: # context: switch title under Menu; Help and support is the name of a section in Facebook's own Menu
Hide Help and support
column2: 隱藏“幫助和支援”

column1: # context: summary of that switch; Settings and privacy is Facebook's own Menu section
The Help and support section leaves Facebook's Menu, header and all. Settings and privacy stays.
column2: “幫助和支援”部分連同標題從 Facebook 選單中消失。“設定和隱私”保留。

column1: # context: switch title under Menu; Settings and privacy is a section of Facebook's own Menu that folds and unfolds when its header is tapped
Keep Settings and privacy expanded
column2: 保持“設定和隱私”展開

column1: # context: summary of that switch
Settings and privacy in Facebook's Menu stays open, so its rows show without a tap.
column2: Facebook 選單中的“設定和隱私”保持展開，無需點按即可看到其中各項。

column1: # context: section title for the search settings, named like Facebook's own search
Search
column2: 搜尋

column1: # context: switch title under Search; Meta AI is Meta's assistant and keeps its name
Hide Meta AI in search
column2: 隱藏搜尋中的 Meta AI

column1: # context: summary of that switch; Meta AI and Ask Meta AI are Meta's own names, as Facebook shows them
Search no longer shows Meta AI answers or Ask Meta AI prompts, or sends your search to Meta AI. Results for people, groups, pages and posts stay.
column2: 搜尋不再顯示 Meta AI 的回答或“詢問 Meta AI”提示，也不再把你的搜尋傳送給 Meta AI。使用者、小組、公共主頁和帖子的結果保留。

column1: # context: settings section heading for the Default comment order switch and its list
Comments
column2: 評論

column1: # context: switch title; on, a post's comments open in the order chosen in the list below it
Default comment order
column2: 預設評論排序

column1: # context: summary of that switch; a link to a comment is one from a notification, say
Use the order below. A choice made on a post lasts until restart. Links to comments keep Facebook's order.
column2: 使用下面的排序。你在某個帖子上所做的選擇會保留到重啟。指向評論的連結仍使用 Facebook 的排序。

column1: # context: switch title under Comments; Meta AI writes a short summary of what a post's comments say
Hide Meta AI comment summaries
column2: 隱藏 Meta AI 評論摘要

column1: # context: summary of that switch; the buttons are a post's Like, Comment and Share row
Hides Meta AI's summary at the top of comments and the comment summary under a post's buttons. The comments themselves stay.
column2: 隱藏評論頂部的 Meta AI 摘要，以及帖子按鈕下方的評論摘要。評論本身保留。

column1: # context: switch title under Comments; Like is the button under a post or a comment
Like only
column2: 僅“贊”

column1: # context: summary of that switch; the reactions are the row of Love, Haha, Wow and the rest that a long press on Like opens
A long press on Like doesn't open the reactions. A tap still likes.
column2: 長按“贊”不會打開回應表情。點按仍然是點贊。

column1: # context: switch title under Comments; GIF and sticker are two buttons in the box where you type a comment
Hide GIF and sticker buttons
column2: 隱藏 GIF 和貼紙按鈕

column1: # context: summary of that switch; the comment box is where you type a comment
The comment box loses its GIF and sticker buttons. Typing, photos and posting work as before.
column2: 評論框不再顯示 GIF 和貼紙按鈕。輸入、照片和釋出照常使用。

column1: # context: switch title under Comments: hides the Add a comment field at the bottom of the full-screen video viewer
Hide the video comment box
column2: 隱藏影片評論框

column1: The Add a comment box under a full-screen video goes away. Comment boxes on posts stay.
column2: 全屏影片下方的評論框會消失。帖子裡的評論框不受影響。

column1: # context: switch title under Comments; a reply thread is the replies under a comment, which Facebook folds behind View replies
Open every reply thread
column2: 展開所有回覆

column1: # context: summary of that switch; View replies is the link Facebook shows under a comment that has replies
Comments show their replies right away, so there's no View replies to tap.
column2: 評論會直接顯示其回覆，因此不用再點按“查看回復”。

column1: # context: switch title under Comments; it makes an open reply thread load the rest of its replies by itself as the list is scrolled
Load whole reply threads
column2: 載入完整回覆

column1: # context: summary of that switch; View more replies is the row Facebook shows under an open thread that has more replies to load
An open reply thread keeps loading as you scroll, so there's no View more replies to tap.
column2: 展開的回覆會在你滾動時持續載入，因此不用再點按“檢視更多回復”。

column1: # context: switch title under Comments; View more replies is the row under an open reply thread that loads more replies, and this makes the whole row take the tap instead of only its words
Tap anywhere on View more replies
column2: 點按“檢視更多回復”整行任意位置

column1: # context: summary of that switch
The whole View more replies row opens the replies, not just its words.
column2: 點按“檢視更多回復”這一整行都能展開回復，而不只是文字部分。

column1: Hide related groups
column2: 隱藏相關小組

column1: A group post's comments end without the Related groups list and its Join buttons.
column2: 小組帖子的評論末尾不再出現“相關小組”列表及其“加入”按鈕。

column1: # context: row title under Comments that opens Facebook's own settings; reaction counts are the numbers next to the reactions on a post
Hide reaction counts
column2: 隱藏回應數量

column1: # context: summary of that row; Preferences and Reaction preferences are the names Facebook's own settings use
Facebook has its own setting for this. Open Facebook's settings, then Preferences and Reaction preferences.
column2: Facebook 有專門的設定。請開啟 Facebook 的設定，然後進入“偏好設定”和“回應偏好設定”。

column1: # context: message shown when Facebook's own settings could not be opened from that row
Facebook's settings didn't open. You'll find Reaction preferences in its Settings, under Preferences.
column2: Facebook 的設定沒有開啟。你可以在它的“設定”中，“偏好設定”下找到“回應偏好設定”。

column1: # context: title of the list of comment orders, and of its dialog
Comment order
column2: 評論排序

column1: # context: entry of that list: the order Facebook's servers pick, which is what happens without Hushfacebook
Facebook's choice
column2: Facebook 的選擇

column1: # context: entry of that list; Facebook's own name for this order in the sort menu of a post's comments
Most relevant
column2: 最相關

column1: # context: entry of that list; Facebook's own name for this order in the sort menu of a post's comments
Newest
column2: 最新

column1: # context: entry of that list; Facebook's own name for this order in the sort menu of a post's comments
All comments
column2: 所有評論

column1: # context: summary of the list when Facebook's choice is picked; Most relevant is Facebook's own name for that order
Comments open in the order Facebook picks, which is usually Most relevant.
column2: 評論按 Facebook 選擇的排序開啟，通常是“最相關”。

column1: # context: summary of the list; %1$s is one of the order names above, as Facebook's sort menu shows it
A post's comments open with %1$s picked in their sort menu, where the post offers it.
column2: 在帖子提供該選項時，評論會按排序選單中選中的“%1$s”開啟。

column1: # context: sentence in the import preview and the toast after an import that sets the comment order to Facebook's choice
Comments will open in the order Facebook picks.
column2: 評論將按 Facebook 選擇的排序開啟。

column1: # context: sentence in the import preview and the toast after an import that sets the comment order; %1$s is one of the order names above
Comments will open with %1$s picked in their sort menu.
column2: 評論將按排序選單中選中的“%1$s”開啟。

column1: # context: switch title under Search; the ads Facebook puts between search results
Hide sponsored search results
column2: 隱藏贊助搜尋結果

column1: # context: summary of that switch
Hides ads between your search results. The results you searched for stay.
column2: 隱藏搜尋結果之間的廣告。你搜索的結果保留。

column1: # context: switch title under News feed; the ads between the posts on a person's profile or a Page
Hide sponsored profile posts
column2: 隱藏個人主頁上的贊助帖子

column1: # context: summary of that switch; Page is Facebook's name for a business or public figure's page
Hides ads between posts on someone's profile or a Page. Their own posts stay.
column2: 隱藏某人的個人主頁或公共主頁上帖子之間的廣告。他們自己的帖子保留。

column1: # context: switch title under News feed; a note is the short text bubble (or a 'Drop a thought' prompt) Facebook shows over a person's profile picture
Hide profile notes
column2: 隱藏個人主頁上的便籤

column1: # context: summary of that switch
Hides the note bubble that sits on profile pictures. Applies the next time you open a profile.
column2: 隱藏頭像上的便籤氣泡。下次打開個人主頁時生效。

column1: # context: what stays in while Hushfacebook is paused, followed by the patch name in brackets; the row in Facebook's own Menu that opens Hushfacebook settings
# context: a short message when the Hushfacebook row in Facebook's Menu couldn't open the settings
Hushfacebook settings can't open here. Long-press the Facebook logo instead.
column2: Hushfacebook 設定無法在這裡開啟。請改為長按 Facebook 徽標。

column1: # context: switch title under News feed; the row of groups Facebook suggests joining, shown between posts
Hide suggested groups
column2: 隱藏推薦小組

column1: # context: summary of that switch; Discover more groups is the label of Facebook's own button under that row
Hides the row of groups to join between posts. Posts from groups you're in stay.
column2: 隱藏帖子之間的待加入小組行。你所在小組的帖子保留。

column1: # context: switch title under News feed; Facebook's own header of a row of Stories from people you don't know, shown between posts
Hide "Stories you might like"
column2: 隱藏“你可能喜歡的快拍”

column1: Hide Memories in the feed
column2: 隱藏動態中的回憶

column1: Hide friend requests in the feed
column2: 隱藏動態中的好友請求

column1: Hide friends' locations
column2: 隱藏好友位置

column1: # context: switch title under News feed, part of Hide suggested and promoted posts; a post opened by tapping a notification
Hide more posts under notification posts
column2: 隱藏通知帖子下的更多帖子

column1: Hides Memories between posts, like "On this day" and friendship anniversaries. Your Memories page stays.
column2: 隱藏帖子之間的回憶，例如“那年今日”和好友紀念日。你的“回憶”頁面保留。

column1: Hides friend requests shown between posts. Your requests stay under Friends.
column2: 隱藏帖子之間顯示的好友請求。你的請求仍在“好友”下。

column1: Hides the card between posts that shows where your friends are.
column2: 隱藏帖子之間顯示好友所在位置的卡片。

column1: # context: summary of that switch; "More from your friends" is the heading Facebook shows over that list
A post you open from a notification ends without the "More from your friends" list Facebook adds under it, which can carry ads.
column2: 從通知開啟的帖子末尾不再出現 Facebook 新增的“來自好友的更多內容”列表，它可能帶有廣告。

column1: Hide the Find friends card
column2: 隱藏“查詢好友”卡片

column1: Hides the "Want to see more posts from friends?" card with its Find friends button where your friends' posts run out.
column2: 隱藏好友帖子結束處帶有“查詢好友”按鈕的“想看更多好友的帖子嗎？”卡片。

column1: # context: summary of that switch; the Stories tray is the row of Stories at the top of the feed
Hides the row of Stories from people you aren't connected to, between posts. Your friends' Stories and the Stories tray stay.
column2: 隱藏帖子之間來自與你沒有關聯的人的快拍行。你好友的快拍和快拍欄保留。

column1: # context: switch title under Notifications; trending videos Facebook sends as push notifications
Block trending video notifications
column2: 遮蔽熱門影片通知

column1: # context: summary of that switch; reels are Facebook's short videos
Trending videos and the reels Facebook picked for you stop showing up in your notifications.
column2: 熱門影片和 Facebook 為你挑選的 Reels 不再出現在你的通知中。

column1: # context: switch title under Notifications; memories are Facebook's posts from past years on the same day
Block memory notifications
column2: 遮蔽回憶通知

column1: # context: summary of that switch; On this day is the name Facebook gives its memories feature
Facebook's "On this day" memories stop showing up in your notifications.
column2: Facebook 的“那年今日”回憶不再出現在你的通知中。

column1: # context: switch title under Notifications; reminders of friends' birthdays
Block birthday notifications
column2: 遮蔽生日通知

column1: # context: summary of that switch
No more reminders that it's a friend's birthday.
column2: 不再提醒好友的生日。

column1: # context: switch title under Notifications; Page is Facebook's name for a business or public figure's page
Block group and Page highlights
column2: 遮蔽小組和公共主頁精選

column1: # context: summary of that switch; creators are the people and Pages who post videos and posts you follow
Digests of what's going on in groups, Pages and creators you follow stop. Comments, replies and mentions still come through.
column2: 你關注的小組、公共主頁和創作者的動態摘要將停止推送。評論、回覆和提及仍會送達。

column1: # context: switch title under Notifications; People you may know is Facebook's name for its friend suggestions, as in Hide "People you may know"
Block "People you may know"
column2: 遮蔽“你可能認識的人”

column1: # context: summary of that switch; friend requests are other notifications, which always come through
Friend suggestions stop showing up in your notifications. Friend requests still come through.
column2: 好友推薦不再出現在你的通知中。好友請求仍會送達。

column1: # context: switch title under Notifications; places near you and weather alerts Facebook sends
Block nearby and weather notifications
column2: 遮蔽附近和天氣通知

column1: # context: summary of that switch
Alerts about places near you and about the weather stop.
column2: 不再推送附近地點和天氣的提醒。

column1: Block account setup reminders
column2: 遮蔽賬號設定提醒

column1: Reminders to finish setting up a Facebook account stop. Login and security alerts still come through.
column2: 不再提醒你完成 Facebook 賬號的設定。登入和安全提醒仍會送達。

column1: # context: switch title under Notifications; group activity is the notifications about new posts and activity in groups you're in
Block group activity notifications
column2: 遮蔽小組動態通知

column1: # context: summary of the group activity switch
Notifications about new activity in your groups stop. Comments, replies and mentions in groups still come through.
column2: 不再推送你所在小組的新動態通知。小組中的評論、回覆和提及仍會送達。

column1: # context: switch title under Notifications; an event invite is someone inviting you to a Facebook event
Block event invites
column2: 遮蔽活動邀請

column1: # context: summary of the event invites switch
Invites to events stop showing up in your notifications.
column2: 活動邀請不再出現在你的通知中。

column1: # context: switch title under Notifications; a live video is a broadcast someone is streaming right now
Block live video notifications
column2: 遮蔽直播影片通知

column1: # context: summary of the live video switch; the ones you asked Facebook for are live notifications you turned on for a person or Page
Notifications that someone is live stop, including the ones you asked Facebook for.
column2: 不再推送有人開播的通知，包括你向 Facebook 要求開啟的那些。

column1: # context: switch title under Notifications; reactions are likes and the other reaction buttons on posts and comments
Block reaction notifications
column2: 遮蔽回應通知

column1: # context: summary of the reactions switch
Likes and reactions to your posts and comments stop showing up in your notifications. Comments still come through.
column2: 對你的帖子和評論的贊與回應不再出現在你的通知中。評論仍會送達。

column1: # context: switch title under Notifications; quiet hours is a stretch of the day when the picked notification kinds are blocked
Quiet hours
column2: 靜默時段

column1: # context: summary of the quiet hours switch; the switches above are the notification switches, the two times below are the start and end rows
The switches above block their kinds only between the two times below. The rest of the day those kinds come through.
column2: 上面的開關只在下面兩個時間之間遮蔽相應型別的通知。一天中的其餘時間，這些通知照常送達。

column1: # context: row title and list title; the time quiet hours begin
Quiet hours start
column2: 靜默時段開始

column1: # context: row title and list title; the time quiet hours finish
Quiet hours end
column2: 靜默時段結束

column1: # context: title of a note under Notifications, below the switches; what no switch there blocks
What always comes through
column2: 始終會送達的內容

column1: # context: text of that note; Android's own settings are the phone's per-app notification categories, which Facebook's server defines
Messages, friend requests, comments, mentions, calls, login alerts and any kind not listed above always arrive. Android's notification settings for Facebook can block more.
column2: 訊息、好友請求、評論、提及、通話、登入提醒以及上面未列出的任何型別的通知始終會送達。Facebook 在 Android 通知設定中的選項可以遮蔽更多。

column1: # context: switch title under Stories; the stories Facebook suggests in the Stories tray from accounts you don't follow
Hide suggested stories
column2: 隱藏推薦快拍

column1: # context: summary of that switch; Suggested is the label Facebook shows under such a story in the tray, and the tray reloads on its own schedule
Shows only friends and followed Pages in the Stories tray. Applies when Facebook next loads the tray.
column2: 快拍欄中只顯示好友和已關注的公共主頁。在 Facebook 下次載入快拍欄時生效。

column1: # context: switch title under Marketplace; the ads Facebook puts between the things people sell in Marketplace's feed
Hide sponsored Marketplace listings
column2: 隱藏贊助 Marketplace 商品

column1: Block Instant Games ads
column2: 遮蔽 Instant Games 廣告

column1: Games you play in Facebook show no ads. A game that asks for one is told there's none, so rewarded ads give no reward.
column2: 你在 Facebook 中玩的遊戲不顯示廣告。遊戲請求廣告時會被告知沒有，因此激勵廣告不會給出獎勵。

column1: # context: summary of that switch; a boosted listing is one its seller paid Facebook to show to more people
Hides ads and boosted listings in Marketplace's feed and search results. Regular listings stay.
column2: 隱藏 Marketplace 動態和搜尋結果中的廣告與推廣商品。普通商品保留。

column1: # context: switch title under News feed; hides posts whose text holds a word or phrase the person listed
Hide posts with words you choose
column2: 隱藏含你所選字詞的帖子

column1: Hide posts from people, Pages and sites
column2: 隱藏來自使用者、公共主頁和網站的帖子

column1: Hides posts by people or Pages on your list below, or linking to sites on it, including shares. Your list stays on this phone unless you export it.
column2: 隱藏你在下方列表中的使用者或公共主頁釋出的帖子，或連結到列表中網站的帖子，包括轉發的帖子。除非你匯出，否則你的列表只儲存在這部手機上。

column1: People, Pages and sites to hide
column2: 要隱藏的使用者、公共主頁和網站

column1: One per line, up to %1$d: a name as Facebook shows it, a profile or Page ID, or a site like example.com, which also covers addresses like m.example.com. Capital letters don't matter. A Facebook link works when it has the ID in it.
column2: 每行一個，最多 %1$d 個：Facebook 上顯示的名稱、個人主頁或公共主頁 ID，或像 example.com 這樣的網站（也涵蓋 m.example.com 這樣的地址）。不區分大小寫。包含 ID 的 Facebook 連結也可以使用。

column1: One name, ID or site per line
column2: 每行一個名稱、ID 或網站

column1: Nobody listed yet, so no post is hidden.
column2: 還沒有列出任何內容，因此不會隱藏任何帖子。

column1: %1$d person, Page or site.
column2: %1$d 個使用者、公共主頁或網站。

column1: %1$d people, Pages or sites.
column2: %1$d 個使用者、公共主頁或網站。

column1: Your list of people, Pages and sites to hide will be empty.
column2: 你要隱藏的使用者、公共主頁和網站列表將為空。

column1: Your list of people, Pages and sites to hide will hold %1$d entry.
column2: 你要隱藏的使用者、公共主頁和網站列表將包含 %1$d 項。

column1: Your list of people, Pages and sites to hide will hold %1$d entries.
column2: 你要隱藏的使用者、公共主頁和網站列表將包含 %1$d 項。

column1: # context: summary of that switch; the keep list is the second list under it, and a settings file is the one Export settings writes
Hides posts containing a word or phrase from your list below. Words that keep a post win over it. Your words stay on this phone unless you export them.
column2: 隱藏包含下方列表中字詞或短語的帖子。保留帖子的字詞優先於它。除非你匯出，否則你的字詞只儲存在這部手機上。

column1: # context: title of the row and dialog holding the list of words and phrases that hide a post
Words to hide
column2: 要隱藏的字詞

column1: # context: title of the row and dialog holding the list of words and phrases that keep a post even when it has a word to hide
Words that keep a post
column2: 保留帖子的字詞

column1: # context: message of the Words to hide dialog; %1$d is how many phrases a list holds (50), %2$d and %3$d the shortest and longest phrase in characters (2 and 60)

One word or phrase per line, up to %1$d lines, each %2$d to %3$d characters long. A single emoji or Chinese, Japanese or Korean character is enough on its own. Capital letters don't matter, and a phrase matches anywhere in a post's text, even inside longer words.
column2: 每行一個字詞或短語，最多 %1$d 行，每行 %2$d 到 %3$d 個字元。單個表情符號或單箇中文、日文、韓文字元就足夠了。不區分大小寫，短語會匹配帖子文字中的任意位置，即使在更長的詞語內部也會匹配。

column1: # context: message of the Words that keep a post dialog; %1$d is how many phrases a list holds (50), %2$d and %3$d the shortest and longest phrase in characters (2 and 60)

A post with any of these stays, even when it also has a word to hide. One per line, up to %1$d lines, each %2$d to %3$d characters long. A single emoji or Chinese, Japanese or Korean character is enough on its own.
column2: 含有其中任何一項的帖子會保留，即使它同時含有要隱藏的字詞。每行一個，最多 %1$d 行，每行 %2$d 到 %3$d 個字元。單個表情符號或單箇中文、日文、韓文字元就足夠了。

column1: # context: hint in the empty text box of both word list dialogs
One word or phrase per line
column2: 每行一個字詞或短語

column1: # context: toast after saving a word list, one line left out; %2$d and %3$d are the shortest and longest phrase in characters
%1$d line was left out. A phrase needs %2$d to %3$d characters, but a single emoji or Chinese, Japanese or Korean character is enough. One given twice counts once.
column2: 有 %1$d 行被忽略。短語需要 %2$d 到 %3$d 個字元，但單個表情符號或單箇中文、日文、韓文字元就足夠了。重複的只算一次。

column1: # context: toast after saving a word list, several lines left out; %2$d and %3$d are the shortest and longest phrase in characters
%1$d lines were left out. A phrase needs %2$d to %3$d characters, but a single emoji or Chinese, Japanese or Korean character is enough. One given twice counts once.
column2: 有 %1$d 行被忽略。短語需要 %2$d 到 %3$d 個字元，但單個表情符號或單箇中文、日文、韓文字元就足夠了。重複的只算一次。

column1: # context: summary of the Words to hide row while it's empty
No words yet, so no post is hidden.
column2: 還沒有字詞，因此不會隱藏任何帖子。

column1: # context: summary of the Words that keep a post row while it's empty
No words yet.
column2: 還沒有字詞。

column1: # context: summary of a word list row holding one phrase
%1$d word or phrase.
column2: %1$d 個字詞或短語。

column1: # context: summary of a word list row holding several phrases
%1$d words or phrases.
column2: %1$d 個字詞或短語。

column1: # context: line under a word list being edited: how full the room both lists share would be; %1$d is a whole percent
Both lists together fill %1$d%% of the room they share.
column2: 兩個列表合計佔用了它們共用空間的 %1$d%%。

column1: # context: under a word list being edited, and when its Save is refused: more phrases than a list holds; %1$d is the most a list holds
A list holds up to %1$d phrases, and this one has more. Remove some, then save again.
column2: 一個列表最多容納 %1$d 個短語，而這個列表超出了。請刪除一些後再儲存。

column1: # context: under a word list being edited, and when its Save is refused: both lists would take more than the room they share; %1$d is a whole percent past 100
Both lists together would fill %1$d%% of the room they share. Remove or shorten some phrases, then save again.
column2: 兩個列表合計將佔用它們共用空間的 %1$d%%。請刪除或縮短一些短語後再儲存。

column1: # context: added to the Words to hide summary: posts the filter hid since Facebook last started, one
Hid %1$d post since Facebook started.
column2: 自 Facebook 啟動以來已隱藏 %1$d 個帖子。

column1: # context: added to the Words to hide summary: posts the filter hid since Facebook last started, several
Hid %1$d posts since Facebook started.
column2: 自 Facebook 啟動以來已隱藏 %1$d 個帖子。

column1: # context: sentence in the import preview and the toast after an import that empties the list of words to hide
Your list of words to hide will be empty.
column2: 你要隱藏的字詞列表將為空。

column1: # context: sentence in the import preview and the toast after an import; the list of words to hide will hold one phrase
Your list of words to hide will hold %1$d word or phrase.
column2: 你要隱藏的字詞列表將包含 %1$d 個字詞或短語。

column1: # context: sentence in the import preview and the toast after an import; the list of words to hide will hold several phrases
Your list of words to hide will hold %1$d words or phrases.
column2: 你要隱藏的字詞列表將包含 %1$d 個字詞或短語。

column1: # context: sentence in the import preview and the toast after an import that empties the keep list
Your list of words that keep a post will be empty.
column2: 你保留帖子的字詞列表將為空。

column1: # context: sentence in the import preview and the toast after an import; the keep list will hold one phrase
Your list of words that keep a post will hold %1$d word or phrase.
column2: 你保留帖子的字詞列表將包含 %1$d 個字詞或短語。

column1: # context: sentence in the import preview and the toast after an import; the keep list will hold several phrases
Your list of words that keep a post will hold %1$d words or phrases.
column2: 你保留帖子的字詞列表將包含 %1$d 個字詞或短語。

column1: # context: section title for the settings about writing posts and comments
Writing
column2: 撰寫

column1: # context: switch title under Writing; @ is the at sign that starts a mention and stays as it is
Tag suggestions only after @
column2: 僅在輸入 @ 後顯示標記建議

column1: # context: summary of that switch; the list is Facebook's list of people to tag, and @ stays as it is
Type @ before Facebook suggests someone to tag in posts or comments. Your text stays unchanged.
column2: 輸入 @ 後，Facebook 才會建議在帖子或評論中標記的人。你的文字保持不變。

column1: # context: switch title under Playback; on, a long video you left partway starts again where you left it
Resume long videos
column2: 繼續播放長影片

column1: # context: summary of that switch; the seek bar is the bar under a video you drag to move through it; Reels is Facebook's name for its short videos
Videos over two minutes pick up where you left off. Drag the bar to start elsewhere. Short reels, live videos and ads start as usual.
column2: 超過兩分鐘的影片會從你上次離開的位置繼續播放。拖動進度條可從其他位置開始。短 Reels、直播影片和廣告照常開始。

column1: # context: switch title under Playback; a frame is one still picture of a video
Frame step
column2: 逐幀播放

column1: # context: summary of that switch; Reels is Facebook's name for its short videos
With a reel or video paused, tap its right side to step one frame forward and its left side to step one frame back. Tap the middle to play.
column2: 在 Reels 或影片暫停時，點按其右側可前進一幀，點按左側可後退一幀。點按中間則播放。

column1: # context: switch title under News feed, right below Hide AI-detected posts; on, posts their creator labelled as AI go too
Also hide posts labeled as AI
column2: 同時隱藏標有 AI 標籤的帖子

column1: Hide Meta AI in the feed
column2: 隱藏動態中的 Meta AI

column1: Hides Meta AI cards between posts and cards promoting the Vibes app. People's posts stay, whatever they say about AI.
column2: 隱藏帖子之間的 Meta AI 卡片和推廣 Vibes 應用的卡片。使用者釋出的帖子保留，無論其中怎麼談論 AI。

column1: Hide AI character posts
column2: 隱藏 AI 角色帖子

column1: Hides posts featuring Meta's AI characters, the chatbots people make with Meta AI Studio. Off by default, since it hasn't been tried on a real feed yet.
column2: 隱藏包含 Meta AI 角色的帖子，即使用者通過 Meta AI Studio 製作的聊天機器人。預設關閉，因為尚未在真實動態上試過。

column1: # context: summary of that switch; the AI label is the one Facebook shows next to the poster's name on such posts
Also hides posts their creator labeled as made with AI, not just the ones Facebook detects itself. Off by default, since it hasn't been tried on a real feed yet.
column2: 同時隱藏創作者自行標註為 AI 製作的帖子，而不只是 Facebook 自己檢測到的。預設關閉，因為尚未在真實動態上試過。

column1: Return to regular Facebook
column2: 恢復為普通 Facebook

HDR videos and photos stay at your screen's usual brightness instead of turning it up to full. They keep their resolution.
column2: HDR 影片和照片保持螢幕的常規亮度，而不是把亮度調到最大。它們保留原有解析度。

column1: # context: switch title under Playback, below Turn off HDR brightness; when a video comes in both HDR and SDR, the SDR copy plays. Keep HDR and SDR as they are
Play SDR versions of HDR videos
column2: 播放 HDR 影片的 SDR 版本

column1: # context: summary of that switch; "the same size" means the same resolution; "the switch above" is Turn off HDR brightness
When Facebook also sends an HDR video in SDR at the same size, play that version instead. The screen doesn't brighten and the picture stays as sharp. Works with the switch above on or off.
column2: 當 Facebook 同時以相同尺寸提供某個 HDR 影片的 SDR 版本時，播放該版本。螢幕不會變亮，畫面同樣清晰。無論上面的開關開啟還是關閉都有效。

column1: # context: switch title under Playback; it makes videos play past the silent stretches of their sound
Skip silent parts
column2: 跳過無聲片段

column1: # context: summary of that switch; how-tos are tutorial videos
Videos, reels and stories jump past the quiet stretches in their sound, so talks and how-tos get to the point sooner.
column2: 影片、Reels 和快拍會跳過聲音中的安靜片段，讓講話和教程更快進入正題。

column1: # context: switch title under Playback; feed videos stay silent until the user turns their sound on
Keep feed videos muted
column2: 動態影片保持靜音

column1: # context: summary of that switch; the speaker is the sound button on a video, volume up is the phone's key
Videos in your feed start with the sound off every time you open Facebook, and only you turn it on. Tap a video's speaker or press volume up to hear it.
column2: 每次開啟 Facebook 時，動態中的影片都會靜音播放，只有你自己能開啟聲音。點按影片的揚聲器圖示或按音量加鍵即可收聽。

column1: # context: switch title under Playback; keeps a video's progress bar (the line showing how far it has played) on screen
Keep the progress bar
column2: 保持進度條顯示

column1: # context: summary of that switch; a reel is a short vertical video
A reel's progress bar stays full size, ready to drag. A full-screen video's controls stay until you tap.
column2: Reels 的進度條保持完整大小，隨時可以拖動。全屏影片的控制元件會保持顯示，直到你點按。

column1: Show a reel's time
column2: 顯示 Reels 時間

column1: With Keep the progress bar on, a reel's elapsed and total time stay above the bar. Off, they show only while you drag it.
column2: 開啟“保持進度條顯示”後，Reels 的已播放時間和總時長會一直顯示在進度條上方。關閉後，只有在你拖動時才顯示。

column1: # context: switch title under Playback, after Show a reel's time; a tap on the video's progress bar jumps to that point
Tap the bar to seek
column2: 點按進度條跳轉

column1: # context: description of that switch; the dot is the bar's round handle you drag
Tap anywhere on a reel's or video's progress bar to jump there, instead of dragging the dot.
column2: 點按 Reels 或影片進度條上的任意位置即可跳轉到那裡，無需拖動圓點。

column1: # context: switch title under Marketplace; View profile is Facebook's own button on a seller's Marketplace page that opens their regular Facebook profile, so use Facebook's label for it in this language
Show View profile on Marketplace sellers
column2: 在 Marketplace 賣家上顯示“檢視個人主頁”

column1: # context: summary of that switch
Adds a View profile button to every seller's Marketplace page, opening their Facebook profile. Facebook only shows it to some accounts.
column2: 在每位賣家的 Marketplace 頁面新增“檢視個人主頁”按鈕，開啟其 Facebook 個人主頁。Facebook 只向部分賬號顯示它。

column1: # context: the Save Facebook's notification sound row under Notifications and its toasts (#83)
Save Facebook's notification sound
column2: 儲存 Facebook 的通知提示音

column1: Adds Facebook's chime to your phone's notification sounds, for categories set to None. Then pick it in Android's notification settings for Facebook, under Sound.
column2: 把 Facebook 的提示音新增到手機的通知提示音中，供設為“無”的類別使用。然後在 Android 中 Facebook 的通知設定裡，於“提示音”下選擇它。

column1: Saved as %1$s in the Notifications folder. Pick it under Sound in Android's notification settings for Facebook.
column2: 已作為 %1$s 儲存在“通知”資料夾中。請在 Android 中 Facebook 的通知設定裡，於“提示音”下選擇它。

column1: %1$s is already in your notification sounds.
column2: %1$s 已在你的通知提示音中。

column1: This build has no notification sound to save.
column2: 此版本沒有可儲存的通知提示音。

column1: Couldn't save the sound. Try again.
column2: 無法儲存提示音。請重試。

column1: # context: switch title on the Feed page; the composer row is the "What's on your mind?" box at the top of Home where a post starts
Hide the composer row
column2: 隱藏發帖欄

column1: # context: summary of that switch; use the wording Facebook itself uses in this language for "What's on your mind?" and Home
Hides the "What's on your mind?" row at the top of Home. The create button in the top bar still starts a post.
column2: 隱藏主頁頂部的“你在想什麼？”一行。頂欄中的建立按鈕仍可發帖。

column1: # context: switch title under Reels and Watch; Clean mode is Facebook's own three-dot menu item on a reel or video that hides the buttons down the side, so use Facebook's name for it in this language (#75)
Always use Clean mode
column2: 始終使用簡潔模式

column1: # context: summary of that switch; "the usual way" means Facebook's own way out of Clean mode
Opens reels and videos in Facebook's Clean mode, which hides the buttons down the side. You can still leave Clean mode as usual. Off by default, since it hasn't been tried on a real account yet.
column2: 在 Facebook 的簡潔模式下開啟 Reels 和影片，它會隱藏側邊的按鈕。你仍可像往常一樣退出簡潔模式。預設關閉，因為尚未在真實賬號上試過。

column1: # context: switch title under Reels and Watch, part of Clean up Reels; each reel plays to its end one time and stops there instead of starting over
Play reels once
column2: Reels 只播放一次

column1: # context: summary of that switch; "last frame" is the final picture of the video, which stays on screen

A reel stops on its last frame instead of starting over. Tap it to watch again, or swipe to the next one. Feed videos and stories aren't changed. Off by default, since it hasn't been tried on a real account yet.
column2: Reels 播放到最後一幀後停止，而不是重新開始。點按可再看一遍，或滑動到下一個。動態訊息中的影片和快拍不受影響。預設關閉，因為尚未在真實賬號上試過。

column1: # context: switch title under Reels and Watch, part of Clean up Reels; reels and videos play in the language they were recorded in instead of an audio track Facebook translated
Keep the original audio
column2: 保留原始音訊

column1: # context: summary of that switch; "dubbed" means the spoken audio was replaced by a translated voice; Meta AI is the company's AI assistant, keep the name
Reels and videos play with the sound they were made with, not a version Facebook dubbed into your language with Meta AI. Off by default, since it hasn't been tried on a real account yet.
column2: Reels 和影片按原本製作時的聲音播放，而不是 Facebook 用 Meta AI 配音成你所用語言的版本。預設關閉，因為尚未在真實賬號上試過。

column1: # context: settings section title on the App page, above the switches of Hide Meta upsells; Meta is the company
Meta's other products
column2: Meta 的其他產品

column1: # context: switch title; Edits is Meta's video editing app, keep its name
Hide Edits promotions
column2: 隱藏 Edits 推廣

column1: # context: switch title; Threads is Meta's app, keep its name; cross-posting means sharing a Facebook post to Threads as well
Hide Threads cross-posting prompts
column2: 隱藏 Threads 同步釋出提示

column1: # context: switch title under Meta's other products; Threads is Meta's app, keep its name; the share sheet is the panel that opens when you tap Share on a post, use Facebook's own word for it in this language
Hide Threads in the share sheet
column2: 隱藏分享面板中的 Threads

column1: # context: switch title under Meta's other products; Muse is Meta's AI agent app, keep its name; the share sheet is the panel that opens when you tap Share on a post, use Facebook's own word for it in this language
Hide Muse in the share sheet
column2: 隱藏分享面板中的 Muse

column1: # context: switch title; Meta Verified is Meta's paid subscription, keep its name
Hide Meta Verified offers
column2: 隱藏 Meta Verified 優惠

column1: # context: switch title; avatar stickers are stickers made from your Facebook avatar
Hide avatar sticker promotions
column2: 隱藏頭像貼紙推廣

column1: # context: summary of the Edits switch; the pill is a small button under a video in the feed that opens Edits
Hides the Edits button in the Reels composer and the Edits pill under videos. You can still make reels in Facebook.
column2: 隱藏 Reels 創作介面中的 Edits 按鈕，以及影片下方的 Edits 小按鈕。你仍可在 Facebook 中製作 Reels。

column1: # context: summary of the Threads switch; the composer is where you write a new post
Facebook stops asking whether to share your post to Threads too. Posting to Facebook works as before.
column2: Facebook 不再詢問是否把你的帖子同時分享到 Threads。釋出到 Facebook 照常使用。

column1: # context: summary of the Threads share sheet switch; the share sheet is the panel that opens when you tap Share on a post
Removes the Threads button when you share something. All other ways to share stay, in the same order.
column2: 分享內容時移除 Threads 按鈕。其他所有分享方式保留，順序不變。

column1: # context: summary of the Muse share sheet switch; Muse is Meta's AI agent app, keep its name
Removes Muse, Meta's AI agent app, when you share something. All other ways to share stay, in the same order.
column2: 分享內容時移除 Muse（Meta 的 AI 智慧體應用）。其他所有分享方式保留，順序不變。

column1: # context: summary of the Meta Verified switch; the label is a line Facebook adds under the poster's name on some posts
No Meta Verified offer after you post, and no Meta Verified label under the names on posts. Posting works as usual.
column2: 發帖後不再出現 Meta Verified 優惠，帖子上的姓名下方也不再顯示 Meta Verified 標籤。發帖照常進行。

column1: # context: summary of the avatar sticker switch; promotion slots are the cards Facebook uses to suggest its own features
Hides avatar sticker promotions in comments and elsewhere, and the prompt to make an avatar. Stickers still send.
column2: 隱藏評論等位置的頭像貼紙推廣，以及製作頭像的提示。貼紙仍可傳送。

column1: # context: switch title under Meta's other products; Imagine is Meta AI's image maker, keep its name
Hide Meta AI's Imagine
column2: 隱藏 Meta AI 的 Imagine

column1: # context: switch title under Meta's other products; Meta AI is Meta's assistant and keeps its name; the buttons sit under some posts
Hide other Meta AI buttons under posts
column2: 隱藏帖子下方其他 Meta AI 按鈕

column1: # context: summary of the Imagine switch; Imagine me is a button Facebook puts under some posts, keep its name; Create story is Facebook's screen for making a story, use Facebook's own name for it in this language
Hides the Imagine me button on posts and the Imagine option when you write a post or create a story. Everything else works as before.
column2: 隱藏帖子上的 Imagine me 按鈕，以及撰寫帖子或建立快拍時的 Imagine 選項。其他一切照舊。

column1: # context: summary of the switch that hides the other Meta AI buttons; these are buttons Facebook puts under some posts that open Meta AI; the next button is whatever other button the post would show there
Hides the other Meta AI buttons Facebook puts under posts. The post's next button shows instead, if it has one.
column2: 隱藏 Facebook 放在帖子下方的其他 Meta AI 按鈕。如果帖子還有下一個按鈕，會改為顯示它。

column1: # context: label of a switch under Stories that replays a finished story; it works together with the Stop Story auto-advance switch
Loop stories
column2: 迴圈播放快拍

column1: # context: summary of the Loop stories switch; "Stop Story auto-advance" is the label of the switch above it, so use its translation
With Stop Story auto-advance on, a finished story plays again from the start instead of waiting on its last frame. Tap or swipe to move on.
column2: 開啟“停止快拍自動切換”後，播放完的快拍會從頭再播，而不是停在最後一幀。點按或滑動可繼續。

column1: # context: label of a switch under Downloads that adds a Save photo item to the three-dot menu of posts with photos
Save photo in post menus
column2: 帖子選單中的儲存照片

column1: # context: summary of the Save photo in post menus switch; "Save any photo" is the label of the switch above it and "Save photo" is the menu item, so use their translations
With Save any photo on, a post with photos gets Save photo in its three-dot menu too. A post with several saves each one, one after another.
column2: 開啟“儲存任意照片”後，帶照片的帖子在其三點選單中也會有“儲存照片”。包含多張照片的帖子會逐張依次儲存。

column1: # context: menu item in a post's three-dot menu that saves the post's one photo to the phone
Save photo
column2: 儲存照片

column1: # context: menu item in a post's three-dot menu that saves every photo of a post with several photos
Save all photos
column2: 儲存所有照片

column1: # context: short message shown when the photos of a post could not start saving
Couldn't save this post's photos. Try again in a moment.
column2: 無法儲存此帖子的照片。請稍後重試。

column1: # context: row in a comment's long-press sheet that saves the GIF the comment holds; keep it short like Save photo
Save GIF
column2: 儲存 GIF

column1: # context: message after a tap on Save GIF when the save didn't start
Couldn't save this GIF. Try again in a moment.
column2: 無法儲存此 GIF。請稍後重試。

column1: # context: sentence added after the summary of the Save any photo switch; Save GIF is the row's name, keep it as translated for that row
A GIF comment gets Save GIF when you long-press it.
column2: 長按 GIF 評論即可看到“儲存 GIF”。

column1: Couldn't save this story's photo. Try again in a moment.
column2: 無法儲存此快拍的照片。請稍後重試。

column1: Too many saves at once. Try again when one finishes.
column2: 同時儲存的數量太多。請等其中一個完成後再試。

column1: # context: settings switch under Block Instant Games ads that makes a game's rewarded ad count as watched
Answer rewarded game ads as watched
column2: 將遊戲獎勵廣告視為已觀看

column1: # context: description under that switch
With Block Instant Games ads on, a game's rewarded ad counts as watched. No ad plays and the game still gives its reward.
column2: 開啟“遮蔽 Instant Games 廣告”後，遊戲的獎勵廣告會算作已觀看。不會播放任何廣告，遊戲仍會給出獎勵。

column1: # context: title of the list that picks the quality reels start at
Reels quality
column2: Reels 畫質

column1: # context: title of the list that picks the quality video stories start at
Stories quality
column2: 快拍畫質

column1: # context: first choice in the Reels and Stories quality lists: follow the Playback quality row; use this language's name for that row
Same as Playback quality
column2: 與播放畫質相同

column1: # context: summary of the Reels quality list when it follows the Playback quality row
Reels follow the Playback quality row.
column2: Reels 沿用“播放畫質”一行的設定。

column1: # context: summary of the Stories quality list when it follows the Playback quality row
Video stories follow the Playback quality row.
column2: 影片快拍沿用“播放畫質”一行的設定。

column1: # context: summary of the Reels quality list when it has a quality of its own; %1$s is that choice, such as Highest or Up to 720p
%1$s for reels, whatever Playback quality is set to.
column2: Reels 使用“%1$s”，不論“播放畫質”如何設定。

column1: # context: summary of the Stories quality list when it has a quality of its own; %1$s is that choice, such as Highest or Up to 720p
%1$s for video stories, whatever Playback quality is set to.
column2: 影片快拍使用“%1$s”，不論“播放畫質”如何設定。

column1: # context: title of the row naming a folder inside the save folder that video saves go in
Video subfolder
column2: 影片子資料夾

column1: # context: title of the row naming a folder inside the save folder that photo saves go in
Photo subfolder
column2: 照片子資料夾

column1: # context: dialog text of the Video subfolder row
Choose a folder for videos inside the save folder. Invalid characters become underscores. Leave it blank to keep videos in the save folder itself.
column2: 在儲存資料夾內為影片選擇一個資料夾。無效字元會變成下劃線。留空則把影片保留在儲存資料夾本身。

column1: # context: dialog text of the Photo subfolder row
Choose a folder for photos inside the save folder. Invalid characters become underscores. Leave it blank to keep photos in the save folder itself.
column2: 在儲存資料夾內為照片選擇一個資料夾。無效字元會變成下劃線。留空則把照片保留在儲存資料夾本身。

column1: # context: summary of the Video subfolder row; %1$s is a folder path such as Movies/Facebook/Clips
Videos go to %1$s.
column2: 影片存入 %1$s。

column1: # context: summary of the Photo subfolder row; %1$s is a folder path such as Pictures/Facebook/Photos
Photos go to %1$s.
column2: 照片存入 %1$s。

column1: # context: switch that takes the new-item dot and count off the Home tab
Hide the Home tab badge
column2: 隱藏“主頁”標籤頁角標

column1: # context: switch that takes the new-item dot and count off the Friends tab
Hide the Friends tab badge
column2: 隱藏“好友”標籤頁角標

column1: # context: switch that takes the new-item dot and count off the Marketplace tab
Hide the Marketplace tab badge
column2: 隱藏 Marketplace 標籤頁角標

column1: # context: switch that takes the new-item dot and count off the Notifications tab
Hide the Notifications tab badge
column2: 隱藏“通知”標籤頁角標

column1: # context: switch that takes the new-item dot and count off the Menu tab
Hide the Menu tab badge
column2: 隱藏“選單”標籤頁角標

column1: # context: switch that takes the new-item dot and count off the Groups tab
Hide the Groups tab badge
column2: 隱藏“小組”標籤頁角標

column1: # context: switch that takes the new-item dot and count off every tab without a switch of its own
Hide other tabs' badges
column2: 隱藏其他標籤頁的角標

column1: # context: switch that keeps Facebook from putting its count on the launcher icon
Hide the app icon count
column2: 隱藏應用圖示上的數字

column1: # context: summary of the switch for the badges on every tab without a switch of its own
No dot or count on Feeds, Gaming, Events and the other tabs not listed here. The Reels tab has its own switch.
column2: “動態”、“遊戲”、“活動”以及此處未列出的其他標籤頁上不顯示圓點或數字。Reels 標籤頁有單獨的開關。

column1: # context: summary of each tab's badge switch
No dot or count on this tab. Its page still shows what's new when you open it.
column2: 此標籤頁上不顯示圓點或數字。開啟它時，頁面仍會顯示有哪些新內容。

column1: # context: summary of the app icon count switch
No number on Facebook's app icon. Notifications still arrive. Some launchers add their own count, which this can't remove.
column2: Facebook 的應用圖示上不顯示數字。通知仍會送達。有些桌面啟動器會自行新增數字，這裡無法移除。

column1: # context: switch title under News feed; it shows posts and reel captions in their original language instead of Facebook's automatic translation
Turn off auto-translation
column2: 關閉自動翻譯

column1: # context: description of that switch; See translation is the name of Facebook's own link under a post that translates it on request
Posts and reel captions stay in the language they were written in. Facebook's See translation link stays under them.
column2: 帖子和 Reels 的說明文字保持其撰寫時的語言。帖子下方仍有 Facebook 的“檢視翻譯”連結。

column1: # context: switch title under Reels and Watch, below Keep the reel speed; it keeps a playback speed picked on a feed or Watch video for the next videos
Keep the video speed
column2: 保持影片播放速度

column1: # context: description of that switch; the gear menu is the settings button on a video's player, where Playback speed is picked
The speed you pick in a feed or Watch video's menu carries over to the next videos. Reels keep their own speed. Off by default, since it hasn't been tried on a real account yet.
column2: 你在動態訊息或 Watch 影片的選單中選擇的速度會延續到後面的影片。Reels 保持各自的速度。預設關閉，因為尚未在真實賬號上試過。

column1: # context: switch title under Downloads, below Download feed and Watch videos; it offers to download a reel or video whose link the user copied
Offer to download copied links
column2: 提示下載已複製的連結

column1: # context: description of that switch; Download feed and Watch videos is the name of the switch above it
With Download feed and Watch videos on, coming back to Facebook with a reel or video link copied offers to download it, once per link. Off, Facebook doesn't look at what you copied.
column2: 開啟“下載動態訊息和 Watch 影片”後，帶著已複製的 Reels 或影片連結回到 Facebook 時，會提示下載它，每個連結只提示一次。關閉後，Facebook 不會檢視你複製了什麼。

column1: # context: title of the dialog that offers to download the video whose link is on the clipboard; the link shows under it
Download the video you copied?
column2: 要下載你複製的影片嗎？

column1: # context: button of that dialog that declines; the same link is never offered again
No thanks
column2: 不用了

column1: # context: toast when a copied share link couldn't be followed to a video, so Facebook opened the link itself
Couldn't find the video in that link, so it opened in Facebook instead.
column2: 在該連結中找不到影片，因此改為在 Facebook 中打開了它。

column1: # context: toast when Download on a copied link opens the video first, so Facebook loads it and the save can start
Opening the video to save it
column2: 正在開啟影片以便儲存

column1: # context: switch title under Stories, View stories anonymously's second switch; it adds an eye button over each story
Mark as seen button
column2: “標為已看”按鈕

column1: # context: description of the Mark as seen button switch
Adds an eye button to the top of each story while you view anonymously. Tap it to show up on that story's viewer list. The other stories stay hidden.
column2: 匿名檢視時，在每個快拍頂部新增一個眼睛按鈕。點按它即可出現在該快拍的檢視者名單中。其他快拍仍保持隱藏。

column1: # context: what TalkBack reads for the eye button over a story while that story is still hidden from its viewer list
Mark as seen
column2: 標為已看

column1: # context: what TalkBack reads for the eye button once the story is marked and waiting to be sent; a second tap takes the mark back
Marked as seen. Tap again to undo.
column2: 已標為已看。再次點按可撤銷。

column1: # context: what TalkBack reads for the eye button once the marked story was sent as seen
Marked as seen and sent
column2: 已標為已看並已傳送

column1: # context: the word lists' dialogs, after their first paragraph: a line between slashes is a regular expression; %1$d is how many a list holds, %2$d the most characters each

Usage statistics uploads

Facebook's on-phone learning jobs stop too, and a change applies after Facebook restarts.
column2: Facebook 在手機端的學習任務也會停止，更改會在 Facebook 重啟後生效。

Reel watch history

Reels you've already seen may come back.

Hide group buttons in the share sheet

column2: 當你選擇兩個或更多人時，去掉“傳送給小組”以及分享面板自帶的新建小組方式，這樣分享內容不會意外建立群聊。“分別傳送”保留。

Share the post's own link
column2: 分享帖子自身的連結

column1: # context: that switch's summary. Copy link is the share sheet item of that name; facebook.com/share/ is a web address and stays as written
Copy link and the share sheet's other link shares give the post's own facebook.com address instead of a facebook.com/share/ link made for that one share.
column2: “複製連結”和分享面板中的其他連結分享，會給出帖子本身的 facebook.com 地址，而不是為這一次分享生成的 facebook.com/share/ 連結。

column1: # context: switch title under Comments in Hushfacebook settings, after Hide related groups
Hide comments with shop links
column2: 隱藏帶購物連結的評論

column1: # context: that switch's summary. Shopee, Lazada and Amazon are online shops and stay as written
Hides comments that link to a shop like Shopee, Lazada or Amazon, along with their replies.
column2: 隱藏連結到 Shopee、Lazada 或 Amazon 等商店的評論，以及它們的回覆。

Hide comments with your words
column2: 隱藏含你所選字詞的評論

Hides comments containing a word from your Words to hide list in News feed, along with their replies. Words that keep a post keep a comment too.
column2: 隱藏包含“動態訊息”中“要隱藏的字詞”列表裡字詞的評論，以及它們的回覆。“保留帖子的字詞”也會保留評論。

Quick setups

Quick setups hidden. Bring it back from %1$s.

Quick setups on the home page

Quiet

column2: 隱藏廣告、推薦、推廣和提示，並停止煩人的通知。

Holds back usage reports and camera roll scans, removes link tracking, and hides your typing and screenshots.
column2: 限制使用情況報告和相機膠捲掃描，移除連結跟蹤，並隱藏你的輸入狀態和截圖。

Back to defaults
column2: 恢復預設

Puts every feature switch but Lock Facebook back the way it started.
column2: 把除“鎖定 Facebook”以外的所有功能開關恢復到初始狀態。

Changed %1$d setting

Changed %1$d settings
column2: 已更改 %1$d 項設定

The connection failed. Check your internet and try again.

Facebook's server didn't send the file. Try again in a moment.
column2: Facebook 的伺服器沒有傳送該檔案。請稍後重試。

column1: # context: toast and Last save row: the file a save fetched came empty or cut short
The download ended before the whole file arrived. Try again.
column2: 整個檔案還沒傳完下載就結束了。請重試。

Your phone couldn't write the file. Check your free space and try again.
column2: 你的手機無法寫入該檔案。請檢查剩餘空間後重試。

column1: # context: toast and Last save row: the phone was measured and has too little free space for a save
Not enough free space to save this. Free some up and try again.
column2: 剩餘空間不足，無法儲存。請騰出一些空間後重試。

column1: # context: toast and Last save row: a video's picture and sound couldn't be converted or joined; Download quality is the setting's name
Your phone couldn't put this video together. Try another Download quality.
column2: 你的手機無法合成這個影片。請嘗試其他“下載畫質”。

column1: # context: toast and Last save row: the gallery refused a finished photo or video
The file couldn't be copied into your phone's gallery. Try again in a moment.
column2: 無法把該檔案複製到手機相簿。請稍後重試。

column1: # context: title of a switch on the Menu settings page: whether the Hushfacebook settings shortcut shows when you hold Facebook's launcher icon
Settings shortcut on the app icon
column2: 應用圖示上的設定快捷方式

Open settings from the logo
column2: 從徽標開啟設定

Settings row in Menu
column2: 選單中的設定行

Puts Hushfacebook settings in the menu you get by holding Facebook's icon. Off, it leaves that menu.
column2: 把 Hushfacebook 設定放入長按 Facebook 圖示時出現的選單。關閉後它會從該選單中消失。

column1: # context: summary of the switch for opening the settings with a long press on the Facebook logo
A long press on the Facebook logo at the top of the home feed opens these settings. Off, the long press goes back to Facebook.
column2: 長按主頁動態頂部的 Facebook 徽標會開啟這些設定。關閉後，長按恢復為 Facebook 原有的行為。

column1: # context: summary of the switch for the Hushfacebook settings row in Facebook's Menu
Adds a Hushfacebook settings row at the end of Settings and privacy in Facebook's Menu. Off, the row leaves the Menu.
column2: 在 Facebook 選單的“設定和隱私”末尾新增一行 Hushfacebook 設定。關閉後，這一行會從選單中消失。

column1: # context: summary shown instead of a switch's usual one while it is the only one of the three ways into the settings still on, so it is greyed out
The last way into these settings stays on.
column2: 進入這些設定的最後一種方式會保持開啟。

column1: # context: switch title on the Appearance settings page: hides Facebook Flex's Data mode bar under the top bar; Data mode is Facebook's own name for paid mode on Flex carriers
Hide the Data mode banner
column2: 隱藏“資料模式”橫幅

column1: # context: switch title on the Appearance settings page: hides Facebook Flex's purple Free mode bar; Free mode is Facebook's own name for the free text-only mode
Hide the Free mode banner
column2: 隱藏“免費模式”橫幅

column1: # context: summary of the Hide the Data mode banner switch
On carriers with Facebook Flex, hides the Data mode bar under the top bar and its button to buy mobile data.
column2: 在使用 Facebook Flex 的運營商網路上，隱藏頂欄下方的“資料模式”欄及其購買行動數據的按鈕。

column1: # context: summary of the Hide the Free mode banner switch; the purple bar is also where you switch back to Data mode
On carriers with Facebook Flex, hides the purple Free mode bar. That bar is also how you go back to Data mode, so turn this off when you want to switch.
column2: 在使用 Facebook Flex 的運營商網路上，隱藏紫色的“免費模式”欄。該欄也是切換回“資料模式”的入口，所以想切換時請關閉此項。

column1: # context: switch title under Picture-in-picture on the Playback page: the small window opens only from the Picture-in-picture row this adds to a reel's three-dot More menu, not when you leave Facebook
Only from a reel's More menu
column2: 僅限 Reels 的“更多”選單

column1: # context: summary of that switch; Picture-in-picture is the name of the row in the reel's menu, translated as the row is; the three dots are the reel's own menu button
Leaving Facebook doesn't open the window. Tap Picture-in-picture in a reel's More menu (the three dots) when you want one. That row is there whenever Picture-in-picture is on.
column2: 離開 Facebook 時不會開啟小視窗。需要時，請點按 Reels“更多”選單（三個點）中的“畫中畫”。只要“畫中畫”開啟，該行就會存在。

column1: # context: switch title under Picture-in-picture on the Playback page; the button floats over a reel or video and opens the small window when tapped
Picture-in-picture button
column2: 畫中畫按鈕

column1: # context: summary of that switch; "the window" is the small picture-in-picture window
Shows a small button at the left edge of a reel or video that has the window ready. Tap it to open the window right away. Works with Picture-in-picture on.
column2: 在已準備好小視窗的 Reels 或影片左側邊緣顯示一個小按鈕。點按它可立即開啟小視窗。需開啟“畫中畫”。

column1: # context: switch title under Stories; it makes videos you post to your own Story ask for high quality when they upload
Upload Stories in HD
column2: 以高畫質上傳快拍

column1: # context: summary of that switch; standard is the normal upload quality, high the better one
Videos you post to your Story ask Facebook for its high upload quality instead of standard. Applies to the next Story you post.
column2: 你釋出到快拍的影片會向 Facebook 請求高畫質上傳，而不是標準畫質。對你下次釋出的快拍生效。

column1: # context: switch title under Stories; a photo story is a still picture posted to your own Story, and a song added to it plays while the picture shows
Longer music on photo stories
column2: 延長照片快拍的音樂

column1: # context: summary of that switch; 15 seconds is how long Facebook lets the song on a photo play, and the song's length can be shorter than 30
A song you add to a photo for your Story plays for up to 30 seconds instead of 15. Applies to the next song you pick.
column2: 你為快拍照片新增的歌曲最長可播放 30 秒，而不是 15 秒。對你下次選擇的歌曲生效。

column1: # context: switch title under Stories; two fingers spread apart on a story or a profile photo make it bigger
Pinch to zoom
column2: 雙指縮放

column1: # context: summary of that switch; "let go" means lifting your fingers off the screen
Pinch a story or a photo on someone's profile to zoom in. It goes back when you let go.
column2: 在快拍或別人個人主頁上的照片上用雙指張開即可放大。鬆開手指後恢復原樣。

column1: # context: switch title under Stories, right below Pinch to zoom; the zoomed picture stays zoomed after the fingers lift
Stay zoomed
column2: 保持放大

With Pinch to zoom on, the photo or story stays zoomed when you let go, and a story stays paused. Drag with one finger or pinch again. Tap or press Back when you're done.
column2: 開啟雙指縮放後，鬆開手指時照片或快拍會保持放大，快拍也會保持暫停。單指拖動或再次雙指縮放。看完後輕點螢幕或按返回鍵。

column1: # context: switch title under Stories, right below Stay zoomed; two quick taps on a photo zoom it in where you tapped
Double tap to zoom
column2: 雙擊縮放

column1: # context: summary of that switch; "Pinch to zoom" is the label of the switch two rows above it, so use its translation; a story is the full-screen picture or video someone shares for a day
With Pinch to zoom on, double tap a photo on a profile to zoom in where you tapped, and double tap again to put it back. A single tap still opens the photo, a moment later.

Hide the Messenger count

Download first in post menus

Long press opens comments

column1: # context: summary of the double tap switch
A double tap on a reel opens its comments instead of liking it. Turn off double tap to like still wins when it's on. Off by default, since it hasn't been tried on a real account yet.
column2: 雙擊 Reels 會開啟它的評論，而不是點贊。開啟“關閉雙擊點贊”時，以它為準。預設關閉，因為尚未在真實賬號上試過。

column1: # context: summary of the long press switch

Holding a reel opens its comments instead of Facebook's long-press menu or the 2x hold. The reel's more button still opens that menu. Holding a feed post's photo or the line with its name opens that post's comments, and holding its text or a profile picture works as before. Off by default, since it hasn't been tried on a real account yet.
column2: 按住 Reels 會開啟它的評論，取代 Facebook 的長按選單或 2 倍速按住。Reels 的“更多”按鈕仍可開啟那個選單。按住動態中帖子的照片或帶名字的那一行會開啟該帖子的評論，按住文字或頭像則和以前一樣。預設關閉，因為尚未在真實賬號上試過。

column2: 在動態訊息和 Watch 影片選單中新增“用其他應用開啟”。它會把影片交給播放器或投屏應用，例如 VLC 或 Web Video Caster。沒有單個檔案可交出的影片會給出提示。

Keeps a list on this phone of the reels, videos and stories you watch, so you can find one again after the feed refreshes. Nothing leaves your phone.

Comments open on a sheet that fills the screen instead of stopping part way up. On reels and videos, Comment opens that sheet in place of the split view with the video on top.
column2: 評論面板會鋪滿整個螢幕，而不是隻展開一部分。在 Reels 和影片上，“評論”按鈕會開啟這個面板，而不是影片在上方的分屏檢視。

Hide the status bar

Takes the phone's status bar, with the time and battery, off Facebook's main screen, so the app gets the whole screen. Swipe down from the top edge to see it for a moment.
column2: 在 Facebook 主介面隱藏手機的狀態列（時間和電量），讓應用佔滿整個螢幕。從螢幕頂部邊緣向下滑動可暫時檢視。

Open feed videos on their own

A video you tap in the feed opens full screen by itself, with no reels to swipe to after it. The Reels tab keeps scrolling. Off by default, since it hasn't been tried on a real account yet.

Hides posts from groups you haven't joined, like a friend's post in a public group. Posts from your groups and a friend's share of a group post stay.

column1: # context: switch title under Search; For you is the section of searches Facebook suggests on the search screen before anything is typed, under a header that reads For you
Hide For you in search
column2: 在搜尋中隱藏“為你推薦”

column1: # context: summary of that switch; recent searches are the user's own past searches, and the suggestions as you type are the ones under the search box while typing
Hides the For you searches Facebook suggests when you open search. Your recent searches and the suggestions as you type stay.
column2: 開啟搜尋時不再顯示 Facebook 推薦的“為你推薦”搜尋。你的最近搜尋和輸入時的建議會保留。

Hides the People you may know row Facebook shows when you open search. Your recent searches and the suggestions as you type stay.
column2: 開啟搜尋時不再顯示 Facebook 的“你可能認識的人”一欄。你的最近搜尋和輸入時的建議會保留。

Don't save search history
column2: 不儲存搜尋記錄

What you search for, and the pages and profiles you open from a search, aren't added to your Facebook search history. Searches already there stay until you delete them.
column2: 你搜索的內容，以及你從搜尋中開啟的主頁和個人資料，都不會加入你的 Facebook 搜尋記錄。已有的搜尋會保留，直到你刪除。

Hide the audio line on reels

column1: # context: summary of that switch; "Original audio" is Facebook's own label, so use the wording Facebook shows in this language
Takes the line with the reel's sound, "Original audio" or a song, off the bottom of reels. Other info stays. A change shows from the next reel.
column2: 去掉 Reels 底部顯示聲音的那一行（“原創音訊”或歌曲）。其他資訊保留。更改會從下一個 Reels 開始顯示。

column1: # context: switch title under Reels and Watch; the message is Facebook's own "This is taking a while. Try checking your network connection." that pops up while a video or GIF loads slowly
Hide the slow connection message
column2: 隱藏網路連線慢的提示

column1: # context: summary of that switch; "This is taking a while" is Facebook's own message, so use the wording Facebook shows in this language
Stops the "This is taking a while" message about your network connection when a video or GIF is slow to load. It keeps loading as before.
column2: 影片或 GIF 載入慢時，不再彈出“載入時間較長”這條關於網路連線的提示。內容照常繼續載入。

column1: # context: switch title under Reels and Watch; the Reels row is the strip of reel tiles Facebook shows between posts in the news feed, each tile playing a short clip of its reel over and over
Play whole reels in the feed's Reels row
column2: 在動態的 Reels 欄中完整播放 Reels

The reels in your feed's Reels row play from the start and keep going, instead of repeating a second or two. Tiles drawn after a change pick it up.

column1: # context: title of the row on the Appearance page, with AMOLED in the build, that takes a color code for dark mode's backgrounds; also its dialog's title
Background color

column2: 深色模式背景的顏色程式碼（#RRGGBB），例如 #0D1117。最淺可用到約 %1$s 的灰色。留空則使用 %2$s，即修補 Hushfacebook 時設定的顏色。

column1: # context: summary of that row while it's blank; %1$s is the color code the patch wrote, like #0D1117
Uses %1$s, the color Hushfacebook was patched with. Type a color code to change it.
column2: 使用 %1$s，即修補 Hushfacebook 時設定的顏色。輸入顏色程式碼即可更改。

column1: # context: summary of that row with a color saved; %1$s is that color code, like #0D1117
Dark mode's backgrounds use %1$s. Restart Facebook to see the change.
column2: 深色模式背景使用 %1$s。重啟 Facebook 後可看到更改。

column1: # context: shown when Save is tapped on that row with text that isn't a color code; %1$s is what was typed; keep #RRGGBB and #0D1117 as they are

column2: “%1$s”不是顏色。請輸入六位顏色程式碼（#RRGGBB），例如 #0D1117，或留空以使用修補 Hushfacebook 時設定的顏色。

column2: %1$s 是半透明的。請輸入不透明的六位顏色程式碼（#RRGGBB），例如 #0D1117。

column1: # context: shown when Save is tapped on that row with a color too light for Facebook's white text; %1$s is what was typed, %2$s the lightest gray code it takes

column2: %1$s 太淺，Facebook 的文字會難以看清。請選擇更深的顏色。最淺可用到約 %2$s 的灰色。
